messages:
Sam R: Kicking off canary for v2.7.1 to prod in the 02:00-03:00 UTC change window. deploy-bot: started rollout: 10% traffic -> monitor.

deploy-bot: PRELIGHT CHECKS: metrics stream hooked, SLO baseline captured, tracing enabled. no infra alerts at start. (https://observability/redwood/canary/v2.7.1)

Priyanka: noticing p95 jump ~+120ms on embed-service for the canary cohort, sample size ~300 requests so far. p50 looks fine.

Joan L: could be the kvcache miss pattern — last week we saw similar short-lived p95 blips during GC. which hosts are serving the canary?

Marta (oncall): infra shows kvcache GC ran at 02:12 UTC in eu-west-1, and one host had an OOM eviction ~02:11. correlates with a small spike in latency there.

Sam R: pausing the ramp. holding at 10% for now. deploy-bot: ramp paused (manual) by Sam R.

Priyanka: raw error rate for canary window is 0.8% 5xx vs baseline 0.2%. 5 of 8 5xx are 503 backend timeouts.

Joan L: can you paste the backend proxy logs for those 503s?

Priyanka: ```
2026-03-21T02:12:35Z embed-proxy id=abc123 backend=embed-svc-3 status=503 latency=2500ms trace=trc-01
2026-03-21T02:12:40Z embed-proxy id=abc124 backend=embed-svc-5 status=200 latency=62ms trace=trc-02
2026-03-21T02:13:01Z embed-proxy id=abc126 backend=embed-svc-3 status=503 latency=2300ms trace=trc-03
```

Marta (oncall): routing logs show ~12% of canary traffic routed to embed-svc-3 which had the OOM eviction; infra restarted that host at 02:14 and it rejoined healthy.

Sam R: decision for now: keep at 10% for 15 minutes and observe. Rollback criteria: if rolling 5xx > 1.2% sustained over a 15m window OR p95 elevated >100ms above baseline for 15m, then rollback to v2.7.0. Also pin fallback route config so rollback is immediate.

deploy-bot: acknowledged. fallback v2.7.0 pinned and rollback threshold applied.

Priyanka: adding note to release log: https://redwood/internal/releases/v2.7.1 - flagged potential kvcache-correlated latency. Also kicking off a targeted eval against the canary prompt set.

Joan L: I'll create a smoke trace sampling rule for the canary cohort to capture future 5xx traces (trace-id example: trc-01).

Marta (oncall): muting noisy infra alerts from the kvcache GC during this ramp so SRE can focus on SLO signals only. I'll keep the SLO alert active.

Sam R: plan: unpause to 25% in 10m if stable (no 5xx >1.2% and p95 within +100ms). If not stable, rollback. Thanks team. :thumbsup:

Priyanka: ack, monitoring dashboards and will post updates every 5m.

deploy-bot: ramp resumed to 25% at 02:25 UTC (manual resume by Sam R).
